# D20 Test

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#D20Test)*

D20 Tests encompass the three main d20 rolls of the game: [ability checks](Ability-Check.md), [attack rolls](../Combat/Attacks/Attack-Roll.md), and [saving throws](Saving-Throw.md). If something in the game affects D20 Tests, it affects all three of these rolls. The DM determines whether a D20 Test is warranted in a given circumstance. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[D20 Tests](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#D20Tests)").
